command.simpleclouds.weather.override:
Simple Clouds is overriding vanilla weather, and the /weather command is disabled. To use vanilla weather, please do either of the following:
1. Set the cloud mode in the SERVER config to 'Vanilla Fallback'.
2. Set the cloud mode in the SERVER config to 'Single', and set the single mode cloud type to a cloud type that has no weather associated with it (e.g. simpleclouds:itty_bitty)

gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.cl:
Specifies how the clouds should behave in a client-side only context. 'Single' uses only a single cloud type. 'Vanilla Fallback' carves clouds around the player, keeping them at a distance. Due to be on a client-side only context, 'Simple Clouds' can not be picked and the vanilla weather system will be used. If Simple Clouds is installed on a server, this option will be ignored and the client will instead use the option set by the server.
Default: AMBIENT
Allowed Values: SINGLE, AMBIENT
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.de:
Toggles the generation of the cloud mesh.
Default: true

Toggles rendering of the clouds.
Default: true
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.di:
Specifies the allowed dimensions that Simple Clouds is active in.
Allowed values: minecraft:dimension.

Toggles cloud shadows cast onto terrain, including nearby terrain under overhead clouds and distant terrain when available.
Default: true

Specifies the distance cloud shadows can render across terrain.
 Default: 4096
 Range: 512 ~ 16384
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.pe:
Culls cloud chunks not visible to the player. Generally should not be disabled, but can fix visual issues when looking around fast with higher frames per mesh generation values.
Default: true

Specifies the quality of the level of detail. A lower setting makes clouds lower quality faster.
Default: HIGH
Allowed Values: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH

Specifies if distant level-of-detail cloud chunks should be rendered. Disabling can improve performance, but removes faraway cloud coverage.
Default: true

Specifies if 'rain' beneath storm clouds should appear or not. Disabling can improve performance, especially when in VR.
Default: true

Toggles lightning flashes that can be seen in storm fog. Disabling can lead to potential performance gains when lightning spawns.
Default: true

Specifies if faces that are not visible to the camera should be tested during mesh generation. Setting this to off can improve performance at the cost of visual issues with shadows and storm fog.
Default: true

Specifies the maximum percentage of the total cloud render distance where legacy transparent cubes can be generated. Lower values clamp transparency closer to the player to improve performance.
 Default: 50
 Range: 1 ~ 100
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.pr:
Specifies if new rain sounds should replace the vanilla ones.
Default: true
Custom Rain Sounds

EXPERIMENTAL. Specifies if extra fog and visibility limiting should be applied when the camera is physically inside a cloud.
Default: false
Inside Cloud Fog

Specifies how strongly the world fog color blends toward the cloud color when inside a cloud.
 Default: 0.5
 Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0
Inside Cloud Fog Color Blend

Specifies how far into the horizontal body of a cloud the camera must be before the inside-cloud fog reaches full strength. Lower values make the effect kick in faster.
 Default: 0.55
 Range: 0.01 ~ 1.0
Inside Cloud Fog Horizontal Fade

Specifies the maximum visibility distance, in blocks, when fully inside a cloud. Lower values make cloud interiors denser.
 Default: 96.0
 Range: 4.0 ~ 512.0
Inside Cloud Fog Max Visibility

Specifies how many blocks the inside-cloud fog takes to fade in vertically near the top and bottom of a cloud.
 Default: 40.0
 Range: 1.0 ~ 256.0
Inside Cloud Fog Vertical Fade Distance

Specifies if lightning should have slight random color variation.
Default: true
Lightning Color Variation

Specifies the maximum amount of world darkening applied during the most intense storms. Lower values keep dense storms brighter.
 Default: 0.75
 Range: 0.0 ~ 0.95
Max Storm Darkness

Specifies the angle of the rain, perpendicular to the ground. Higher values makes it more horizontal.
 Default: 15.0
 Range: 0.0 ~ 45.0
Rain Angle

Specifies the angle parallel to the horizon that the storm fog should be directed to.
 Default: 80.0
 Range: 50.0 ~ 90.0
Storm Fog Angle

Specifies the attenuation distance for thunder. The lower the value, the quieter it will be from longer distances.
 Default: 2000
 Range: 100 ~ 20000
Thunder Attenuation Distance
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.se:
Specifies the seed to use for the clouds. Will apply for all servers that the user connects to with the mod on the client-side only.
 Default: 0
 Range: -9223372036854775808 ~ 9223372036854775807

Specifies if the seed set by the 'Cloud Seed' option should be used or not.
Default: false
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.sh:
Specifies if the info pop-up should appear when opening the cloud previewer menu.
Default: true

Shows the Vivecraft notice on startup.
Default: true
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.si:
Specifies the cloud type that should be used when the SINGLE cloud mode is active.
Default: simpleclouds:cumulonimbus
Client Side Single Mode Cloud Type

Specifies the percentage of the cloud render distance that the clouds will be fully faded away, when using the single cloud type mode (e.g. 50 would make the clouds completely disappear past half the cloud render distance).
 Default: 100
 Range: 0 ~ 100

Specifies the percentage of the cloud render distance that the clouds should begin to fade away, when using the single cloud type mode (e.g. 50 would start to make the clouds fade away at half of the cloud render distance).
 Default: 80
 Range: 0 ~ 100
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.vi:
Specifies if a purely visual 2D atmospheric cloud layer should render above the scene.
Default: true

Specifies if normals should be applied to each individual cube in the cloud which applies a bit of shading per cube face. Helps distinguish each individual cube in a cloud.
Default: false

Fallback transparency fade depth for legacy transparent cubes when a cloud type does not define 'transparency_fade'. Higher values produce a thicker transparent band.
 Default: 0.08
 Range: 0.01 ~ 0.5

Specifies if minimal shading should be applied to clouds. May cause performance drops.
Default: true

Specifies if legacy transparent cubes should be generated around cloud edges. This is more expensive than opaque-only clouds but restores the original transparent cube look.
Default: false
gui.simpleclouds.config.client.option.wh:
Specifies if the dimension whitelist should instead be used as a blacklist.
Default: false
gui.simpleclouds.config.server.option.cl:
Specifies how the clouds should behave. 'Simple Clouds' uses all cloud types with the default weather in Simple Clouds. 'Single' uses only a single cloud type and its associated weather. 'Vanilla Fallback' disables localized weather and carves clouds around the player, keeping them at a distance.
Default: DEFAULT
Allowed Values: DEFAULT, SINGLE, AMBIENT

Specifies the movement speed of clouds for this world/server. Lower values make weather transitions and cloud drift slower.
 Default: 0.675
 Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0
gui.simpleclouds.config.server.option.di:
Specifies the allowed dimensions that Simple Clouds is active in.
Allowed values: minecraft:dimension.
Requires restart.
gui.simpleclouds.config.server.option.si:
Specifies the cloud type that should be used when the SINGLE cloud mode is active.
Default: simpleclouds:itty_bitty
gui.simpleclouds.config.server.option.we:
Allows rain to occur in biomes that would normally be too dry for precipitation. Snow biomes still snow as usual.
Default: true

Specifies the minimum storminess required before dry-biome rain overrides can produce precipitation.
 Default: 0.55
 Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

List of biome tags that should be treated as rain-capable dry biomes when dry-biome rain is enabled.
Allowed values: minecraft:tag.

List of biome tags that should behave like normal rain biomes, bypassing dry-biome rain restrictions. These tags are automatically appended to Dry Biome Rain Tags for compatibility.
Allowed values: minecraft:tag.

Specifies the lowest Y level any cloud may spawn at.
 Default: 128
 Range: 0 ~ 2048

Specifies the longest interval until the next lightning strike will spawn, in ticks.
 Default: 160
 Range: 1 ~ 72000

Specifies the shortest interval until the next lightning strike will spawn, in ticks.
 Default: 10
 Range: 1 ~ 72000
gui.simpleclouds.config.server.option.wh:
Specifies if the dimension whitelist should instead be used as a blacklist.
Requires restart.
Default: false

gui.simpleclouds.error.couldNotLoadMeshS:
Failed to load the mesh compute shader. Please make a bug report on the mod's GitHub repository, linked below. Make sure to include the crash report and latest.log file with your issue.

To developers: If you are modifying the cube_mesh.comp file using a resource pack and have made an error, this message will appear on start up. Please see the latest.log for more details.
gui.simpleclouds.error.opengl:
The currently selected display adapter does not support Simple Clouds.

Simple Clouds only supports display adapters that have OpenGL 4.3+ capabilities.

Please make sure:
1. Your drivers are up to date
2. You are not using integrated graphics instead of a discrete GPU to run Minecraft.

If you are a MacOS user, Simple Clouds IS NOT SUPPORTED as the OS is stuck on OpenGL 4.1. Unfortunately, this is a limitation that Simple Clouds cannot work around.
gui.simpleclouds.error.recommendations: Please try updating your graphics drivers. If the issue persists, please make a bug report on the Simple Clouds repository, linked below. Make sure to include the crash report with your issue.

simpleclouds.config.preset.high.descript: Restores the fuller Simple Clouds presentation with high detail, distant cloud coverage, storm fog, and terrain shadows enabled.
simpleclouds.config.preset.low.descripti: Cuts distant cloud coverage and some extra visual features for weaker systems while keeping clouds visible.
simpleclouds.config.preset.medium.descri: Balances visuals and performance by lowering level of detail slightly and slowing mesh generation a bit.
simpleclouds.config.preset.off.descripti: Disables Simple Clouds visuals for this player, including cloud rendering, storm fog, and atmospheric cloud layers.
